findings.detection: generated index contains content_refs pointing to spec IDs that do not exist as keys in the same index
findings.detail: New entries reference `specs/scripts/nasa-style-check` and `specs/docs/nasa-se-playbook` (both added as keys), but `@specs/docs/nasa-se-playbook` content_refs `specs/scripts/nasa-style-check` while `@specs/scripts/nasa-style-check` content_refs `specs/docs/nasa-se-playbook` — a mutual reference cycle between two brand-new specs, which the index's own ref graph records as `specs/scripts/nasa-style-check -> @specs/docs/nasa-se-playbook` and `specs/docs/nasa-se-playbook -> @specs/scripts/nasa-style-check`.

findings.detection: index entry renamed/re-keyed but stale duplicate key left behind
findings.detail: `@unknown/index.spec.md` was replaced by `@specs/agents/implementation` for the same file `agents.spec.dir/index.spec.md`, yet the `specs` map still lists `@specs/agents/implementation` while the `content_refs` reverse map and `total_specs` count (472→475) must reconcile — the old `@unknown/index.spec.md` key is gone from `specs` but `@bugs/integration-test-template`, `@demo/hello-dir`, `@specs/docs/changelog`, `@examples/greeting-dir` are added to the orphan/unreferenced list at the bottom while their `specs` entries were removed, indicating dangling references.

findings.detection: content_refs removed from entries that still exist, dropping previously-declared references
findings.detail: `@bugs/integration-test-template` had its `content_refs` emptied (`specs/related-spec`, `specs/bugs/other-bug` removed) and `@demo/hello-dir`, `@examples/greeting-dir`, `@specs/docs/changelog` similarly lost all content_refs, yet these IDs are now listed in the trailing orphan array — the change silently drops reference edges rather than fixing them.

review.summary: The regenerated _index.json introduces a mutual content_ref cycle between the two new NASA specs and leaves several entries with emptied content_refs now flagged as orphans, but these are index-data consistency issues rather than code defects.
